slides.title: Syntex
docTitle: Statement of Capabilities, Track Record and Technical Capacity

slides.title: Digital Solutions and Intelligent Automation
slides.body: Syntex combines current technology with careful product work to streamline complex processes and automate them, shaped around the needs of each organisation.

problem.label: Problem
problem.text: Organisational processes are usually spread across disconnected systems, spreadsheets and manual coordination. Each request changes hands several times, the same data is kept in several places, and even a simple report can take days.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: We redesign the process around how teams actually work and build one integrated system for it. Data is entered once, repetitive work is automated, and managers see the current status on a live dashboard.

slides.title: We Build Products People Actually Want to Use

items.title: The right solution in the right place
items.text: Before the first line of code, we study the current process up close to see where AI is needed and where a simpler form is enough.

items.title: Strategic innovation
items.text: We spend innovation where it moves the organisation towards its goals. Every new capability is tied to a measurable indicator.

items.title: Better organisational management
items.text: Systems are designed with roles, access levels and management reports, so each manager sees exactly what they need to decide.

items.title: Creativity in the product
items.text: Sometimes a small idea makes a hard task simple, like a map in Jaygah that draws the route to a library seat by itself.

slides.title: Turning Complex Ideas into Focused Product Experiences
slides.lead: Every project is shaped by the organisation's real needs, the right product positioning, and intelligent systems built to support its growth.
slides.label: Experience-led
slides.subtitle: Understanding complex ideas and processes before proposing a solution
slides.body: An accurate solution to a complex process needs current knowledge, experience and close teamwork.

items.title: Agile delivery
items.text: Work moves in short sprints. Each sprint ends with a usable release, and we set the next priorities together.

items.title: Working with your teams
items.text: We work with technical units and end users from day one. Feedback is applied within the same cycle instead of waiting for the end of the project.

items.title: Regular reporting
items.text: Progress reports cover work completed, work in progress, and risks that need an early decision.

slides.title: Every Page, a Piece of Sharif's Mathematics
slides.lead: Each page of Jaygah carries an interactive piece of mathematics that Sharif students know. None of them adds a step to the booking flow.

items.title: Hyperbolic plane
items.text: A tiling of triangles meeting eight at each vertex, in memory of Maryam Mirzakhani, Sharif mathematics graduate and 2014 Fields Medal winner. The cursor slides the plane and each click draws a full geodesic in Sharif yellow.

items.title: Field of formulas
items.text: Behind the dashboard float Khwarizmi's equation, Kashani's pi to 16 digits, Khayyam's equation and Tusi's law of sines. The formula nearest the cursor names its author.

items.title: Route to the seat
items.text: The route from the entrance to the seat is found with A* on the hall map, keeps clear of desks, columns and shelves, and draws itself.

slides.title: Saya

problem.label: Problem
problem.text: Damage was assessed the traditional way and depended entirely on an assessor's judgement. Calculations were slow, and disagreements, human error and inconsistent pricing were common.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: An online tool that calculates the cost of repairing or replacing vehicle parts automatically, for insurance assessors, service centres and individual users.

outs: No dependence on the manual process

slides.text: Despite tight deadlines and real technical complexity, the Syntex team developed our vehicle damage pricing system with precision, discipline and high quality. Every detail was built to our needs and feedback was applied quickly and correctly. The result was a coherent, reliable system that fully met our expectations.
